title: Coordinated regulation of nuclear integrity and STING trafficking by miR-30d suppresses innate immunity in breast cancer.
snippet: Immune evasion is a key driver of tumour evolution and a major barrier to effective cancer therapy, frequently arising through suppression of the cytosolic DNA-sensing cGAS-STING pathway.
